name: crypto.hash.sha1
description: Hashes input using the SHA1 algorithm, which is broken for collision resistance and only here for legacy data; use [crypto.password.hash] for passwords

input.description: String or byte[] content to hash when [filename] is not supplied

filename.description: File to hash when no input content is supplied

format.description: Hash output format: text, raw, or fingerprint

output.description: Resolves to the computed hash as text, raw bytes, or fingerprint according to [format]
